notes.note: Usage coverage now reads the context-only reason from evidence: when every unreported terminal turn carried only context (token pair or engine percent) or an engine's own reportedCost, the provider reason is the occupancy one, as Kiro and Grok had on main while acp was declared occupancy-only; a turn with no usage at all still reads as missing reports. Searched each citing page for coverage reasons and occupancy claims: none names the reason strings, and the monitoring ACP row (occupancy is not consumed tokens; per-turn tokens only for a recorded engine) stays accurate.
